test_list.description: Space-separated list of tests to run. Examples: 'sys proc', 'quick reverse', 'sys procall brute reverse'. See unhide(8) TEST_LIST.

double_check_brute.description: If true, adds the -d flag. Do a double check in brute test to avoid false positive.

log_file_enabled.description: If true, adds the -f flag. Write a log file (unhide-linux.log) in the current directory.

more_checks.description: If true, adds the -m flag. Do more checks. Implies verbose.

alternate_sysinfo.description: If true, adds the -r flag. Use alternate version of sysinfo check in standard tests.

verbose.description: If true, adds the -v flag. Be verbose, display warning message.

unbuffered_stdout.description: If true, adds the -u flag. Do unbuffered write to stdout.

human_friendly.description: If true, adds the -H flag. Provide a slightly human frienlier output.
